body:
release.yml and tests.yml each carry a separate, hand-copied gcc invocation that missed humanness.c (added to the Makefile in S459-87/88). Third real recurrence of this exact bug class. Fixed both, verified locally with the exact CI commands (including a real Windows cross-compile), confirmed the live GitHub Actions run went green. Commit SHANKPIT 5850891.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix CI build failure: missing humanness.c in workflow build lists
